title: Add Quick Actions panel to Command Center
description:
Add a Quick Actions section to the Command Center with common shortcuts: Submit Job, View Policies, Manage Approvals, Open Search.

**Implementation:**
- Create `dashboard/src/components/home/QuickActions.tsx`
- Render 4-6 action cards with icon + label + description
- Each card navigates to the relevant page via React Router
- Use existing Card and Button primitives
- Place in HomePage grid (top section or sidebar area)

**Files:** `dashboard/src/components/home/QuickActions.tsx` (new), `dashboard/src/pages/HomePage.tsx`
definitionOfDone: Quick Actions panel renders on Command Center
At least 4 action cards with proper navigation

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/home/QuickActions.tsx: A responsive grid of 4-6 action cards. Each card: icon (Lucide), label, short description, onClick navigates via useNavigate(). Use Card component for each, responsive grid (2 cols mobile, 3 cols desktop). Hover lift effect.
implementationPlan.note: 6 action cards: Jobs, Policies, Approvals, Search, Audit Log, Packs. Responsive grid (2/3/6 cols). Hover lift effect. Uses Card + Lucide icons.
